Abstract. This fixture exercises the build. For the scalar plant $x_{k+1}=ax_k+bu_k$ with stage cost $\ell=qx^2+ru^2$, the value $V(x)=Px^2$ decreases by exactly the stage cost at every step, the classical argument of receding-horizon control ([[cite:keerthi1988]]; [[cite:mayne2000]]). Every number is printed by code/descent_demo.py.
